Subtract 350 days from 1096-08-12.  
1096 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not a century exception in Gregorian rules for this early date).  
From 1096-08-12 back 350 days:  
Go back 12 days → 1096-07-31.  
Back another 31 days → 1096-06-30.  
Back another 30 days → 1096-05-31.  
Back another 31 days → 1096-04-30.  
Back another 31 days → 1096-03-30.  
Back another 29 days (Feb in leap year) → 1096-01-31.  
Back another 31 days → 1095-12-31.  
Remaining days: 350 - (12+31+30+31+31+29+31) = 350 - 195 = 155 days earlier in 1095.  
From 1095-12-31 back 155 days:  
Back 31 days → 1095-11-30.  
Back 30 days → 1095-10-31.  
Back 31 days → 1095-09-30.  
Back 30 days → 1095-08-31.  
Remaining: 155 - (31+30+31+30) = 155 - 122 = 33 days earlier in 1095-08.  
From 1095-08-31 back 33 days:  
Back 31 days → 1095-07-31.  
Remaining 2 days earlier → 1095-07-29.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1095-07-29
